mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have overcast skies by City Hall with an actual temperature of 79 degrees. We are currently under a waning gibbous moon, and the ISS will be visible crossing the sky from the northwest near Verona High School toward the east northeast starting at 3:31 AM for two minutes. Tonight, the low will be 71 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has officially installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture in Century School Park. This seven-foot artwork, created by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland from a reclaimed ash tree, was donated by Gerri Gurman and reflects traditional Tai Chi movements.

There is plenty to do this week. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the schedule is packed with the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza night at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In our weekly police report, on August 30, officers were called to the 800 block of North Edge Trail for a witnessed incident where a man intentionally smashed a vehicle window. The suspect fled the scene, but an arrest warrant has been issued.
It is a great day for some Chocolate Heath Crunch at Culver's. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10:00 PM tonight.
